gap: Rule semantics versus familiar token triggers
recommendation: Use opposite supplied mappings, nonce labels and paired counterfactual rules; hold out whole predicate compositions.
verification: Exact applicability/state labels and stripped-rule token probes; same status must support both outcomes under different rules.

gap: Serialization and structural generalization are distinct
recommendation: Add input field/list permutations, names and held-out graph motifs; cross size with surface shifts.
verification: Isomorphism/metamorphic replay, renderer read-back and parent-level held-out grids.

gap: Copy/no-op heuristics can mask failed conditional execution
recommendation: Separate applicable change, applicable identity, inapplicable no-op and illegal precondition failures.
verification: Report false-copy/false-apply separately; compare copy and ignore-condition floors per mechanism.

gap: Boundary arithmetic and exact output fidelity
recommendation: Cover threshold equality and near-miss numerical errors; include carry/modulo/delete semantics only when independently implemented.
verification: Independent integer arithmetic and invariants; inspect first-error position and untouched fields.

gap: Hybrid planning success does not establish unaided reusable procedures
recommendation: Create next-action/full-plan demonstrations on fresh worlds and held-out AB/BA/conditional compositions.
verification: Exact replay and behavior criteria; future A/B/C/D plus matched SFT controls required for internalization claim.

gap: Acquisition and retention can trade off despite smaller drift
recommendation: Provide replay/skill obligations and operation-specific competence masks; preserve source retention custody.
verification: Dataset coverage only now; later model acquisition/retention matrix with prospective powered margins.

gap: Trace controls can encode outcomes through filler length
recommendation: Keep target cmp/calc/after stable; freeze filler by TRAIN/public family/action kind and keep student metadata free of gold.
verification: Identical filler within public strata; majority-baseline/MI probe; input read-back and no label fields.

gap: Memory retrieval, correction and belief evidence lack demonstrated dataset coverage
recommendation: Generate timestamped corrections, unresolved conflicts, delayed observations and exact finite belief sets.
verification: Independent provenance/query resolver and observation-consistency enumeration.

gap: Latent, revision and social tasks need sharply scoped exact semantics
recommendation: Use lossless abstractions, bounded edit repair and explicit fictional observation/policy semantics.
verification: Round-trip exactness, minimum-edit certificates and agent-specific information custody; no unsupported architecture benefit claims.

gap: Dataset quality is separate from learning effectiveness and broad intelligence
recommendation: Report semantic-parent coverage and actual review receipts; do not convert synthetic tests or proposed gains into native efficacy.
verification: Release quality gates now; separate authorized training and independent sealed evaluation in the future.
